title: [Bug]:compression_model 启用 stream=True 时 _compress_memory_if_needed 报 AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'metadata'
body: I reproduced the unsafe access on the official v1 branch (ff8064a): an empty streaming compression response leaves last_chunk as None before last_chunk.metadata is read. I will prepare a small PR agai…
